ValidationRule.description: Only 3rd party products can be inserted on recurrings with 3rd party suppliers
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(CONTAINS(Product__r.Name , "(P)"),Supplier__r.Name = "First Mile Ltd", OR(NOT(CONTAINS(Product__r.Name , "(P)")),Supplier__r.Name <> "First Mile Ltd", NOT(CONTAINS(Product__r.Name , "Clearance"))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must attach a partner product if the Supplier is not First Mile Ltd.
